metadata.description: Jason Matthew's personal Claude Code skills marketplace.

plugins.name: adr
plugins.description: Turns an intent into a grounded, cited, build-ready ADR with load-bearing decisions surfaced to the human, then hands it to nightshift:plan's landing step. Front-end for adr → nightshift.

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Cross-provider adversarial plan/design-doc review via OpenAI Codex (GPT-5.6 Terra): verdict-loop protocol, atomic chain guard, cross-repo decision-gate log.

plugins.name: domain-modeling
plugins.description: Actively build and sharpen a project's ubiquitous language — an opinionated CONTEXT.md glossary — by challenging terms, disambiguating overloaded words, and stress-testing domain relationships. Cross-references adr for decision records. Adapted from mattpocock/skills (MIT).

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Frontend/UI design guidance, gated by scope: a light or surgical change gets inline principles; a wide-sweeping or highly-detailed design gets routed to Claude Design in the browser with a paste-ready design brief.

plugins.name: gates
plugins.description: Five stateless PreToolUse gates, a PostToolUse JSON-config guard, and a docs-consolidation trigger. Denies a git commit that changes code without staging its covering docs (per-plugin README/CLAUDE.md pairs, or the nearest README/CLAUDE/AGENTS walking up); asks before a new-project scaffold command runs ahead of an approved design; denies a high-fan-out Workflow script with no per-agent model: override, and asks before a denylisted built-in named workflow; denies an ad-hoc Agent dispatch that omits model unless the agent type pins one in frontmatter; and redirects a shell or Grep search for a code symbol to the LSP tool, but only when the language server it names actually resolves on PATH. A never-blocking trigger counts commits since the .docs-sync record and nudges toward /docs-consolidate. Every gate has an ack marker. Separately, a PostToolUse hook re-parses settings.json/.mcp.json after an edit and reports a syntax error, which Claude Code otherwise swallows by silently dropping the config it cannot parse.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Manual /handoff skill — writes a structured resume doc on demand, auto-loads it on next session.

plugins.name: nightshift
plugins.description: Plan by day, land by night, triage in the morning: scaffolds an overnight landing loop (one task per CI-gated PR, generator + verifier + skeptic, PreToolUse guards, kill switch) into a repo, plus the plan and morning skills around it.

plugins.name: session-retro
plugins.description: Interactive session retrospectives — deterministic activity triggers, one end-of-day offer, batch-scoped diff- and event-log-driven interview, native memory entries. No external services.

plugins.name: ship-gate
plugins.description: Stop-hook gate against trail-off: detects unpushed commits at turn end and injects an agent-directed nudge to review and finish the branch.

plugins.name: writing-artifacts
plugins.description: Positive writing system for durable written artifacts (READMEs, ADRs, PR descriptions, docs, runbooks): reader-expectation prose, Diátaxis document jobs, plain-language structure. Complements reply-style rules in global CLAUDE.md.
